messages:
maya: heads up — Qbringup-2026 (q2b-int4) is live in staging and we see a tiny but consistent drop on the localization promptset compared to qx2b. failing examples look like paraphrase mismatches, not hallucinations. :thinking_face:
santiago: can you paste an example? is this only multilang or also en? :eyes:
maya: mostly multilang (es, fr, ja). here's a short failing pair: 
```
prompt: 'Resume esto en 3 puntos'
golden: 'Resumen: 1) ... 2) ... 3) ...'
q2b: 'Puntos principales: ...'  <-- loses step ordering and drops a bullet
```
eli: hm can we confirm dedupe didn't collapse similar variants into the same holdout? we had an overlap in seedbank last week. might be sampling bias.
anya: I ran a quick embed recall diff — q2b embeddings look slightly shifted vs qx2b, but that wouldn't change ordering semantics. could be tokenizer differences with int4 path.
danny: labeler queue shows more "ambiguous" flags for these prompts. maybe the promptset contains near-duplicate paraphrases that used to anchor the canary. if anchors got deduped away we lose the stable reference.
maya: exactly. hypothesis: our dedupe rolling job removed some anchor paraphrases for longtail locales. we should snapshot which anchors existed in golden for the old model and compare.
santiago: I can run a quick provenance diff. SQL to get anchors by hash: 
```sql
SELECT anchor_id, text, hash, model_version
FROM golden_anchors
WHERE model_version IN ('qx2b-2025', 'q2b-int4-staging')
ORDER BY anchor_id
```
I'll diff hashes and hit count.
labeling-bot: new review batch created: batch_id=rb_20260321_a, size=120, locales=[es,fr,ja], priority=high. Assigned to queue: multilang-anchors.
anya: nice. can we run a small manual relabel of 30 examples first (stratified by locale + length) before full rollover? want to make sure quality delta is real and not sampling noise. :100:
eli: volunteer to do the manual pass for es and fr tomorrow morning. santi can you do ja?
santiago: can do ja. will also run the provenance SQL and push a CSV to /tmp/qbringup-anchor-diff.csv for review.
danny: ops note — staging autoscale bumped GPUs last night, might have triggered a different batching distribution. ops-bot: did you change the runtime kernel flags?
ops-bot: runtime flag update detected on 2026-03-20 02:12 UTC: `kernel_path_optimizer=on` applied to q2b-int4-staging nodes.
maya: that flag was part of the quant rollout perf tune; might affect tokenization boundary handling. we should try a quick A/B: same model but with `kernel_path_optimizer=off` on one canary. any objections?
santiago: sounds good. I'll spin a small canary pool with the flag off and route 10% of canary traffic. add a metric to track "anchor-stability" (new metric = fraction of canary prompts whose top-1 structure matches golden).
anya: for the manual batch, add an extra label field: "structure_match" (yes/no/partial) + freeform note. that will help decide if it's ordering/formatting degradation vs content loss.
danny: I updated the labeling template: `structure_match` enum added. will backfill for existing open tasks.
labeling-bot: reviewers assigned: eli (es,fr), santiago (ja). Batch rb_20260321_a now in progress.
maya: timeline proposal — manual review by EOD tomorrow, provenance diff and canary with flag off by lunch, then decide: revert flag or accept quant path and expand golden anchors to include more paraphrases.
eli: quick Q — if we expand golden anchors, will eval harness account for that (so metrics are comparable)? we need stable evaluation.
santiago: good point. we should version the eval harness promptset (v2) and keep v1 for historical comparison. add an explicit migration note in the canary rollout doc.
anya: also add a small automated script to detect anchor depletion: if fewer than N anchors remain for a locale after dedupe, mark for review. I'll open a tiny PR for that rule. :hammer_and_wrench:
maya: thanks. last ask: whoever touches the golden set, please include a 2-line justification in the commit (why anchor added/removed). auditability is key. :memo:
ops-bot: reminder — deploy freeze window today 18:00-20:00 UTC. plan accordingly. :warning:
eli: copying notes into the qbringup ticket and adding manual labels. will ping when manual pass complete.
santiago: uploaded `/tmp/qbringup-anchor-diff.csv` and a short diff summary: 14 anchors removed in es, 6 in fr, 0 in ja. starting ja review now.
maya: great. we'll reconvene after reviews and decide whether to rollback `kernel_path_optimizer` or expand anchors. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
